projects.description: Modernising the internal analytics dashboard with the sap_horizon theme, responsive DynamicPage layouts, and real-time KPI widgets connected to live OData feeds.
Full-funnel Q3 campaign covering paid search, social, and email channels targeting mid-market B2B buyers across EMEA and North America.
Full review and rewrite of all company HR policies to align with updated labour regulations, DEI commitments, and remote-work best practices.
Comprehensive year-end budget variance analysis and FY2027 budget planning cycle covering all eight business units.
Migrating the remaining on-premise microservices to AWS EKS, including data residency compliance for EU workloads and zero-downtime cutover procedures.
Next-generation self-service customer portal with SSO, real-time order tracking, document management, and a configurable reporting suite.
Complete visual identity refresh including new logo, colour palette, typography system, and brand guidelines applied across all digital and print touchpoints.
Expanding enterprise sales coverage into three new verticals — manufacturing, retail, and public sector — with dedicated account teams and tailored collateral.
Replacing the legacy REST gateway with Kong Enterprise, adding rate limiting, JWT authentication, request tracing, and a developer portal.
Cross-functional initiative targeting 12% operational cost reduction through vendor renegotiation, process automation, and headcount rebalancing.
Developing and executing an integrated organic + paid social strategy across LinkedIn, X, and Instagram, with an influencer programme for product launches.
Deploying autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and a new WMS in the main distribution centre to increase throughput by 40% and reduce pick errors.
Comprehensive audit of all data processing activities, privacy notices, consent mechanisms, and data subject rights procedures to ensure GDPR compliance.
Breaking the monolithic order management application into 12 independently deployable microservices using domain-driven design and event-sourcing patterns.
Defining and aligning the product roadmap for H2 2026, incorporating customer feedback synthesis, competitive analysis, and engineering capacity planning.
Intensified sales effort in the DACH and Benelux regions, targeting 25% new logo growth via localised campaigns, partner events, and inside sales calls.
Redesigning the 90-day onboarding journey with a digital welcome portal, buddy system, structured check-ins, and role-specific learning paths.
End-to-end supply chain redesign covering supplier consolidation, demand forecasting model improvements, and a control-tower dashboard for real-time visibility.
Rebuilding CI/CD pipelines across all 30 repositories using GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and Helm charts, with automated security scanning and DORA metrics tracking.
Implementing HubSpot workflow automation for nurture sequences, lead scoring, and triggered lifecycle campaigns to reduce manual effort by 70%.
Implementing a new tax compliance platform (Vertex O Series) to automate indirect tax calculations across 18 jurisdictions and reduce audit risk.
Six-week discovery sprint using Jobs-to-be-Done interviews, journey mapping, and prototype testing to uncover the highest-value features for the H2 roadmap.
Building a unified observability platform using Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry to give all teams real-time visibility into application health and SLOs.
Deploying Ironclad CLM to centralise contract creation, negotiation workflows, e-signature, and expiry alerts across all business units.
Establishing a tiered partner ecosystem (Silver/Gold/Platinum) with deal registration, MDF allocation, a co-sell playbook, and a partner portal.
Real-time logistics control tower dashboard aggregating carrier data, shipment tracking, cost-per-delivery metrics, and exception alerts for the operations team.
Building an internal AI-powered code review assistant using LLM embeddings to flag security vulnerabilities, style violations, and logic errors before peer review.
Full rebuild of the consumer mobile app in React Native, adding offline mode, biometric auth, push notifications, and a redesigned checkout flow.
Migrated all production workloads from self-managed Kubernetes to EKS with Spot instances, cutting infrastructure costs by 35% and improving cluster reliability.
Creating a shared, accessible React component library with Storybook documentation, automated visual regression tests, and a Figma token sync.
Integrated Salesforce with the ERP and marketing automation platform, enabling unified customer data, automated lead routing, and real-time pipeline visibility.
Building a rolling 18-month financial forecasting model with driver-based inputs, scenario analysis, and automated variance reporting integrated with the BI platform.
Deploying an influencer discovery and campaign management platform to scale creator partnerships from 20 to 200 active influencers across key product categories.
Implementing Samsara fleet telematics across 150 company vehicles to improve route optimisation, driver safety scores, maintenance scheduling, and fuel efficiency.
Comprehensive review of the company's 85-patent portfolio to identify renewal priorities, licensing opportunities, and freedom-to-operate risks in new market segments.
Introducing a GraphQL federation layer on top of existing REST services to unify the data graph, reduce over-fetching, and power the next-generation frontend.
Multi-method UX research study (diary studies, usability tests, and heuristic evaluation) across three core product flows to inform the 2026 redesign agenda.
Structured account expansion programme for the top 20 strategic accounts, combining executive sponsorship, QBRs, and white-space analysis to drive 30% expansion revenue.
Company-wide D&I programme including bias training, pay equity analysis, inclusive hiring practices, an ERG framework, and quarterly progress reporting to the board.
Overhauling the source-to-pay process, introducing a vendor portal, e-procurement system, and a preferred supplier programme to cut cycle times by 50%.
Raised CI/CD maturity from Level 1 to Level 3 across all squads — standardising pipelines, enforcing branch policies, and achieving sub-10-minute build times.
Technical SEO overhaul and content optimisation programme targeting a 40% increase in organic sessions through Core Web Vitals improvements and topic-cluster strategy.
Migrating from the legacy payroll system to ADP Workforce Now, covering multi-country payroll for 500+ employees in 6 countries with automated tax filing.
Building a company-wide experimentation platform on top of LaunchDarkly to enable product, marketing, and engineering teams to run statistically rigorous A/B tests.
Automating the detection and remediation of CVEs across all production containers and OS packages using Snyk and Dependabot, targeting a 48-hour patch SLA.
Establishing a comprehensive data privacy framework covering data classification, retention schedules, privacy-by-design standards, and a data ethics review board.
Entering three new international markets (Japan, Brazil, Australia) with localised go-to-market strategies, in-country hiring, and regulatory compliance planning.
Deploying RFID-based real-time inventory tracking across three warehouses, integrated with the ERP system to eliminate manual cycle counts and reduce stock discrepancies.
Building an MLOps platform on SageMaker to automate model training, evaluation, deployment, and drift monitoring for the company's eight production ML models.
Assessed financial stability, cybersecurity posture, and contractual risk of the top 50 critical vendors, resulting in a tiered risk register and 12 contract renegotiations.
Launching a personalised L&D portal on Degreed, curating learning paths by role and seniority, and integrating with LinkedIn Learning and internal knowledge base.
360-degree integrated launch campaign for the new enterprise product tier, spanning PR, analyst briefings, paid media, roadshow events, and customer success stories.
Deploying a centralised observability stack (Datadog) covering metrics, logs, traces, and synthetic monitoring with SLO dashboards and automated incident routing via PagerDuty.
